findings.evidence_span: combined decoder never returned a wrong secret
findings.rationale: class 1 (Abstract): "combined decoder" appears only in the abstract; the body says grid decoder / full decoder / grid decoder with digest / joint decoding.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the body's single name in the abstract.

findings.evidence_span: per-card repair recovered 36\% and per-card checksums none
findings.rationale: class 1 (Abstract): Baselines for the 99.7% headline are not defined until 5.1, under other labels; cards have no 'checksum'.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the baselines by what they do and reuse those names in 5.1.

findings.evidence_span: any $t$ of $n$ cards recover the secret
findings.rationale: class 1 (Abstract): "card" is never defined as the written share.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'a card is one written share' at first use.

findings.evidence_span: Across every grid experiment in this paper (28{,}000 trials)
findings.rationale: class 1 (5.3 Grids): The 28,000 total has no breakdown and cannot be summed from the rows printed in Tables 2-4.
findings.suggested_fix: State which rows x schemes x trials sum to 28,000.

findings.evidence_span: the original is the unique valid phrase within reach whenever
findings.rationale: class 1 (3.1 The code): "within reach" is never defined and recurs in 4.2 as if a term.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with the explicit condition on substitutions and erasures.

findings.evidence_span: in 97.6\% of trials during development
findings.rationale: class 1 (3.2 Repair beyond substitutions): A percentage with no trial count, harness or table; the 24+2 shorthand is also never introduced.
findings.suggested_fix: Define the N+k shorthand and give the setup, or move the number to 5.2 with data.

findings.evidence_span: so a swap may be combined with

findings.evidence_span: seed followed by $d$ digest words (below)
findings.rationale: class 1 (4.1 Construction): "seed" is undefined and collides with the BIP39 seed (PBKDF2 output); digest words are a forward reference.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'seed words' as the mnemonic words at first use; point to 4.3 by number.

findings.evidence_span: between two distinct dealings in at least
findings.rationale: class 1 (4.1 Construction (Prop. 1d)): "dealing" is never defined.
findings.suggested_fix: Define a dealing after Eq. (3).

findings.evidence_span: For 30-word cards with $k=4$ that
findings.rationale: class 1 (4.1 Construction): The 30-word card is used before it is defined in 4.3.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the standard-card definition into 4.1.

findings.rationale: class 1 (4.2 The unprinted header): The constant 32 and the bound n <= 31 are never explained; hidden rows' header 0 is only in the figure.

findings.evidence_span: With 400 trials a reported percentage has a 95\% confidence half-width of at most 5 points
findings.rationale: class 1 (5.1 Setup): Uncertainty is given only for 400-trial cells; Tables 1, 3, 4 use 200, 300, 250 trials.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the half-width for each trial count.

findings.evidence_span: 24+2 leaves 13--15\% of swaps ambiguous
findings.rationale: class 1 (5.2 Single phrases): Unfiltered-run numbers that no table shows.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the unfiltered columns to Table 1.

findings.rationale: class 1 (5.2 Single phrases / Table 1): The 5.1 outcome vocabulary has no 'ambiguous' category, so the remainder of these cells is unexplained.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'ambiguous' in 5.1 and state the remainder in the caption.

findings.rationale: class 1 (6 Custody Arrangements / Table 4): "refused" and "0" sit side by side unexplained; the 1% clause's scope is unclear.
findings.suggested_fix: Define cell conventions in the Table 4 caption.

findings.evidence_span: bursts far beyond it
findings.rationale: class 1 (4.1 Construction): "burst" is never defined; 5.1 later defines "burn" for the same thing.
findings.suggested_fix: Use one word, defined at first use.

findings.evidence_span: Fix a threshold $t$, a number of cards $n\le 31$, and $k$.

findings.suggested_fix: Use W for phrase length throughout.

findings.evidence_span: The syndromes are linear and each $r_d$ has zero syndromes.
findings.rationale: class 2 (3.2 / 4.1 / 4.3): d means dropped-word count, digest-word count and a row index.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep d for digest words only.

findings.evidence_span: A party holding $h$ words of a
findings.rationale: class 2 (4.2 / 4.5): h was the header symbol and now counts held words; 264 is unexplained.

findings.evidence_span: A protected phrase is
findings.rationale: class 2 (throughout): One object is called protected phrase, valid phrase, parity phrase, codeword, card, share, row, mnemonic; the secret is secret, seed, data words, entropy, key, phrase.

findings.evidence_span: This models per-share correction.

findings.suggested_fix: One label per method everywhere.

findings.evidence_span: When one card is from another dealing
findings.rationale: class 2 (5.1, 5.3, 6): "wrong" labels a fault, an outcome and a card; the foreign card has four names.
findings.suggested_fix: Reserve 'wrong' for the outcome; say 'foreign card' everywhere.

findings.evidence_span: A hidden header and a digest.

findings.evidence_span: A hidden header and a digest.

findings.evidence_span: give the main result. Three

findings.evidence_span: is not shown to reach this bound in every pattern
